svg.title: Paired Modes of the Odd Cycle C5
svg.desc: Two pairs of nonzero modes of C5 with eigenvalues (5−√5)/2 and (5+√5)/2. Cosine and sine components are normalized and rounded to three decimal places. There is no separate alternating mode.

cc:Work.dc:description: Two pairs of nonzero modes of C5 with eigenvalues (5−√5)/2 and (5+√5)/2. Cosine and sine components are normalized and rounded to three decimal places. There is no separate alternating mode.

g.text: Cycle C₅: four modes in two eigenspaces

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #19354a

g.text: In each pair, the Laplacian multiplies by μₖ, and the Greenian by 1/μₖ.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #19354a

g.text: The nonzero modes are shown. The constant mode has components 1/√5.

g.text: An alternating sequence does not close after five steps: there is no separate mode 4.
